scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: Meet Kabir
scenes.caption: Kabir uses an individual festival account. His password manager stores a unique password, and his phone provides another sign-in factor. The team is ready until the phone goes missing.
scenes.dialogue: My account needs a recovery plan too.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Phone missing
scenes.caption: Kabir cannot use the missing phone. His account has a recovery code, but a screenshot stored only on that phone would be unavailable too. Posting the code to the team group would give other people a powerful account key.
scenes.dialogue: Where can I recover access privately?

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Protect recovery
scenes.caption: A long unique password limits reuse risk. M F A or a supported passkey adds sign-in protection. Recovery options must remain private and available after a device is lost. Protecting sign-in and planning recovery are part of one design.
scenes.dialogue: The spare key must survive losing the main key.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Your decision
scenes.caption: Choose storage for a fictional recovery code. The sign-in phone is unavailable and the festival group includes people who should not control this account. Find a route that remains private and usable.
scenes.dialogue: Choose the recovery route that still works.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Recover safely
scenes.caption: Kabir opens the known provider recovery page on a trusted device and proves ownership using a private recovery method. He reviews and revokes the lost device sessions, then registers a replacement method and refreshes recovery options.
scenes.dialogue: Getting back in is not the last step.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Enter the lab
scenes.caption: The service now knows it is Kabir, but that does not mean he can open every folder. Authentication checks identity. Authorisation decides what that identity may do. Test account protection, recovery and access decisions in the lab.
scenes.dialogue: Being signed in does not grant every permission.
